setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A navigator asks whether distant lands might be joined by immense roads, bridges, tunnels, and moving vehicles.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: A family could visit relatives who live far inland, the villagers suppose.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A hunter wonders what roads do to animal migration paths.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A healer considers injuries caused by speed and heavy machines.

text_only.reason: an injury imagined or discussed; nobody is hurt

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A builder imagines rules and signals that prevent collisions, though no system would be perfect.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A parent asks whether children, elders, and people without vehicles could travel freely.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A trader wonders whether roads would favor wealthy settlements over isolated ones.
